name: 26037 · Follansbee, WV
findings: ZIP 26037 (Follansbee) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 26037 (Follansbee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
